evals.name: wrapper-upstream-latest
evals.prompt: descheduler 래퍼 차트 업스트림 최신 버전으로 범프해줘
evals.expected_output: Queries the registry for the latest descheduler chart version before editing; bumps dependencies version, syncs appVersion to upstream appVersion, and handles the wrapper version as past bumps did (mirror upstream, keep fixed, or minor); carries every hunk of the upstream values diff between old and new versions to its upstream position with comments verbatim and keeps local overrides; regenerates Chart.lock only if tracked; touches nothing else; drafts a commit message in the repo's git log convention without committing.

evals.name: image-only-bump
evals.expected_output: Verifies nginx:1.27.5 exists in the registry (e.g. crane digest) before editing; changes appVersion and the explicit image tag only; chart version unchanged; comments and key order preserved; environment override files untouched; no commit made.

evals.name: missing-version-abort
evals.expected_output: Queries the argo-cd chart registry, finds 9.99.0 does not exist, makes no file edits, and reports the latest available argo-cd chart version.

evals.name: wrapper-pinned-image-tag
evals.expected_output: Verifies mimir-distributed 6.2.1 exists; bumps dependencies version and appVersion; notices values.yaml pins image.tag to the old appVersion and moves it to the new appVersion after confirming the tag exists in the registry the values point at; carries the upstream values diff between 6.2.0 and 6.2.1 with comments verbatim, rewriting new image repositories to the repo registry proxy convention; keeps the wrapper version fixed when earlier bumps left it unchanged; helm template shows the new chart label and image tag; no commit made.
